qualificationContract.dueSet: Freeze ledgerDigest and target release; select unresolved rows with release <= target, complete requirement probes whose fullRequirementTarget <= target, and established published regressions. Target or contract changes require a new candidate and reviewed provenance; no automatic deferral.
qualificationContract.candidate: Fresh EXECUTED passing receipts against exact sealed tarball sha512; negative controls required. Missing, skipped, stale, failed or UNKNOWN selected evidence blocks. No future npm lookup.
qualificationContract.published: Repeat frozen due/regression sets on public bytes; npm dist.integrity must equal candidate sha512; bind releaseTransactionId and authenticated install-verified aggregate before closure.
qualificationContract.requirementRegressions: Every previously MET complete requirement and contract-required previously CLOSED gap remains regression-blocking. Partial gap evidence cannot make a full requirement MET.
qualificationContract.futureDebt: Retain future planned probes and unresolved decisions as OPEN / NOT-PROVEN / DECISION-PENDING; no qualification credit.
